messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content:
在這兩手牌中，兩位玩家都拿到同樣的牌型——**同花**（Flush）。  
比較同花的高牌順序：

| 牌序 | 約翰 | 邁克 |
|------|------|------|
| K   | ✔️  | ✔️  |
| Q   | ✔️  | ✔️  |
| J   | ✔️  | ✔️  |
| 10  | ✔️  | ✔️  |
| 9   | ✖️  | ✔️  |
| 8   | ✔️  | ✖️  |

邁克的最高牌是 **9♠**，而約翰的最高牌是 **8♥**。  
因此，邁克的同花比約翰的同花更高，邁克贏得這局撲克。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush from 8 to K? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K is a straight flush (8-9-10-J-Q-K? Wait missing 9♥). He has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's not a straight flush because missing 9♥. It's a flush (all hearts) but not straight. He has high card K. Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a flush (spades). Also missing 8♠. So both flushes. Compare highest card: both have K. Next: Q. Both same. Next: J. Both same. Next: 10. Both same. Next: 9 vs 8. Mike has 9, John has 8. So Mike wins with higher flush. So answer: Mike wins.
